title: Bar Salts Grape Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml By Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape’s Grape offers a deep and rich grape flavour that captures the essence of dark, juicy grapes with every vape. This e-liquid provides a full-bodied grape taste that is both authentic and satisfying, perfect for grape lovers seeking a consistent and flavourful experience throughout the day. Part of Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts collection, this e-liquid is available in a convenient 100ml shortfill format with a 60VG/40PG ratio, tailored for a smooth mouth-to-lung vaping experience. It's designed for use with a variety of MTL devices, supporting coils of 0.6ohm or higher, and ensures a balanced delivery of flavour and vapour. Each bottle allows for the addition of up to two 10ml nicotine shots, enabling you to customize the nicotine strength to your preference, potentially creating up to 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This flexibility makes it an excellent choice for vapers looking to tailor their vaping experience. Discover the wider Vampire Vape Bar Salts range for more exceptional flavours, each developed to offer the same great taste as the most popular disposable vape bars but in a more sustainable and cost-effective format.
